$comment: Bundle size budgets enforced by scripts/bundle-report.js. Values are KB. Tightening these (lowering numbers) is encouraged; loosening requires a justification in CHANGELOG. Official source-plan documents under dist/tiferet are loaded on demand and therefore tracked by a dedicated document budget instead of the interactive application budget. The Tiferet apartment planner adds a responsive three-pane editor, mobile controls and scene-layer UI. The 2026-08-27 complete-experience pass adds the branded site shell, pixel-aligned source overlay, 99-plan catalog, local design-version library and camera presets; measured production totals are 107.7 KB CSS, 3,016.9 KB interactive application, a 525.2 KB main chunk and 23,398.5 KB of on-demand official source/evidence assets. Tight ceilings of 110, 3,050, 530 and 24,000 KB preserve regression headroom; the total-JS and per-source-file limits remain unchanged — see CHANGELOG. v3.54.0 bump: +75 KB JS, +50 KB total to absorb pre-existing organic growth (pdf-renderer + i18n catalog expansion) — see CHANGELOG. v3.58.0 bump: +125 KB JS, +130 KB total to absorb Sprints 16–20 feature growth (rotation lock UI, G-code M6 tool-change, assembly weight, DXF layers, Plugin EventBus, snapshot diff modal) merged into main as part of the production-hardening release — see CHANGELOG. v3.68.0 bump: +100 KB JS, +100 KB total to absorb design-check fix patches + validation engine growth — see CHANGELOG. v4.4.0 bump: +125 KB JS, +125 KB total to absorb Phase 21–23 growth (cost variance, stock tracker, waste analytics, grain report, cut checklist panels + Web Workers). v5.8.0 bump: +100 KB JS, +100 KB total to absorb Phase 24–33 growth (measurement assistant, machine profiles, edge profile, hinge bore, WebXR placement, community catalog, hardware spec engine modules). v5.28.0 bump: +300 KB JS, +300 KB total to absorb Phase 41–52 growth (60+ new engine calculators across Sprints 190–247: wood movement, feed rate, cabinet weight, dowel joint, panel labels, material cost, shop inventory, cabinet templates, edge banding, finger joint, pilot hole, glue-up, bandsaw speed, tablesaw height, mortise-tenon, shelf deflection, router bit, biscuit joint, sanding, miter, shelf pin, drawer slide, wood drying, dovetail, pocket hole, veneer, clamp, drill press, board feet, cabinet door, face frame, drawer box, screw pull-out, kerf bending, dado-rabbet, finishing coat, wood turning, frame-panel, taper jig, stair stringer, box joint, glue coverage, planer passes, honing guide, crown moulding, router circle, cove cut, moisture shrinkage, rafter length, router template, half-lap, spline joint) — see CHANGELOG.
